title: Add support for missing DPoE OAM leaf-branch attributes
description:
The DPoE OAM v2.0 specification defines/references four leaf-branches that
were missing. One of the leaf-branches is defined in the DPoE OAM v2.0
specification. The other three are IEEE 1904.1 SIEPON leaf-branches that
are referenced by the DPoE v2.0 specification.
